name: Shokuchuu Kansen
source:
Crawling tentacles encircle the girl, slipping deeply!
Kotone and her brother were taken to a human-free island.
But human-free doesn't mean desolate.
Something feels very wrong...

The island is crawling with unnatural horrors!!
Kotone is violated by mysterious creatures, and her brother...
Her brother has been hideously transformed!

Some way, some how she needs to protect what remains of him,
so they can both escape this genetically engineered hell! 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE069386.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
爬行的觸手纏繞著女孩，深入體內！琴音和她的哥哥被帶到了一座無人島上。但無人並不意味著荒蕪。感覺有什麼不對勁……島上到處都是非自然的恐怖！！琴音遭到神秘生物性侵，她哥哥則已變成一副駭人的模樣！無論如何，她都要保護他殘存的部分，讓他們兩人逃離這個基因工程的地獄！

［來自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE069386.html]DLsite英文版[/url]］
